role: MapGenScatteredFeature's start half as one structure_type of the shared structure layer: the spacing and salt spawn test on the world Random with the biome check at the chunk centre, and the start that picks a desert pyramid, jungle temple or swamp hut component by biome and sizes its box by coordBaseMode.

structs.name: temple_world (static struct)
structs.java: the World seed and the WorldChunkManager layer stack the spawn test reads

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 132, function temple_piece_new: calloc of each piece; start_add links it into the start's piece-pointer list (heap allocation and pointer graph)
notes: The component constructors here only draw coordBaseMode and size the box; the block half is temple_blocks.c. Temple distances are the vanilla 32/8 defaults, not read from world.conf. Starts are built during chunk generation and population, which run inside the server tick when chunks load. test_structures.c lists "Temple" among its overworld types; which recordings it runs on was not checked.
